A single-page memorial that runs on a 4 KB shader. Visitors leave when they're done; no analytics know they were there.

A site that opens at midnight and closes at dawn. The visual layer is a single
fragment shader; the content layer is a hand-set obituary that took six months
to write. No JavaScript framework. No tracking. The page weighs less than the
favicon on most portfolios.

A bilingual literary press whose entire identity is one Variable typeface and the absence of color.

Fourteen issues so far. Each one ships as a physical broadsheet and a parallel
web edition; the two share nothing but the typography. Online: long-form essays
in a single column, set to 88ch, with footnotes in the margin on desktops and
inline on phones. The phone reading experience is the canonical one.

Six contributors, ninety rooms, one ledger of CC-BY scans. The site is a single
